core_types.name: Client
core_types.description: High-level Go client communicating with containerd over gRPC

core_types.name: Task
core_types.description: Active container process executing in isolated Linux namespaces via shim-v2

core_types.name: Snapshotter
core_types.description: Copy-on-write block or filesystem snapshot driver (overlayfs, devmapper)

concurrency_model.type: gRPC Multi-Tenant Architecture with Out-of-Process Shim Daemons
concurrency_model.synchronization: Locking inside metadata database (bbolt) and shim FIFO queues

cancellation_model.deadline_propagation: Context cancellation propagates to gRPC streams and triggers task SIGTERM/SIGKILL escalation
cancellation_model.leak_prevention: TTRPC stream cleanup and process reaping to prevent zombie child processes

retry_model.strategy: gRPC transport backoff on connection drops to containerd socket

boundaries.network: Unix domain socket (/run/containerd/containerd.sock) and TTRPC shim sockets
boundaries.os: runc, crun, Linux clone(2), setns(2), pivot_root(2), and cgroup filesystem
boundaries.serialization: Protobuf over gRPC / TTRPC and OCI Image/Runtime specifications
